note: Gold answers and accept_patterns are for grading only. build_prompt() sends the reader the rewritten prose and the question text, nothing else.

questions.question: Is the evidence in this figure set development evidence or confirmatory evidence?
Do the figures in this set agree across both models?
questions.gold: Yes, all five agree across Llama and Gemma.

questions.question: Do the later causal and reliability results replicate across both models?
questions.gold: No. They support the narrower Llama result; Gemma misses the required conjunction.

questions.question: What does the passage say you must not do when assembling the paper?
questions.gold: Do not put the M1 suite and the later single-model claims in a shared figure, a shared section, or a spanning summary sentence.
